prompt: Create a strict overhead orthographic trace-evidence plate on the supplied project-generated empty mud background. Preserve exactly four broad sauropod-type corridors, each with two separated rails and alternating smaller manus and larger pes impressions, plus exactly one coherent diagonal route of nine separated tridactyl theropod-type prints. Naturalize the authored marks through spatially correlated depth, substrate response, wear, partial preservation, nonperiodic stride, rail spacing, phase and heading variation. Keep all cross-route prints physically separated with no superimposition. Show no dinosaur bodies, people, text, arrows, horizon, modern marks, fossil slab, chase, attack or timing claim.
overlayWorkflow: The project-authored v2 compositor places exactly four two-rail sauropod-type corridors and one coherent nine-print theropod-type crossing route over the approved empty-mud generation. Fixed seed 2026080701 controls bounded variation in stride, rail width, phase, heading, yaw, depth and partial preservation. It records all impression geometry and rejects periodicity, superimposition or insufficient crossing clearance; it does not reproduce surveyed coordinates or claim track order.
